item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of southern China will be replaced gradually by a warm maritime airstream in the next couple of days. The weather will be humid, foggy and cloudier over the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week. Showers are expected to affect southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
